summary: Well-structured test suite with solid separation of unit tests (SemanticVersionBumper.Tests.ps1) and integration tests (Workflow.Tests.ps1). Unit tests cover all major functions: version reading from files/package.json, bump type determination from conventional commits, version stepping, file updates, and changelog generation. Integration tests properly run 6 functional cases through act with exact output verification (NEW_VERSION, BUMP_TYPE, exit codes, "Job succeeded"). Workflow structure tests validate YAML triggers, permissions, script references, and actionlint. Strengths: comprehensive coverage of requirements, proper use of Pester BeforeAll/AfterAll/AfterEach lifecycle, data-driven test cases, explicit cleanup, error case handling (missing files, invalid versions). Gaps: fixture files referenced but not shown (can't verify they contain correct test data for their assertions); some edge cases untested (empty commit log, malformed commits, package.json missing version field, commit log --- separator parsing logic); output validation is string-pattern based rather than structured parsing. The suite would catch most regressions but has moderate gaps in explicit boundary condition coverage.
